title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
description:
Write a function `celsiusToFahrenheit` that converts a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit using the formula `F = C × 9/5 + 32`.

**Example:**
```js
celsiusToFahrenheit(0)   // 32
celsiusToFahrenheit(100) // 212
celsiusToFahrenheit(-40) // -40
```
ai_context: Integer division pitfall: writing `9/5` in some languages gives 1, but JavaScript always does floating-point division, so `9/5` is `1.8` — no cast needed. The common mistake here is getting operator precedence wrong, e.g. `c * 9 / (5 + 32)` instead of `(c * 9 / 5) + 32`.
